name: Subirats (Spain)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of green, black and green, with a round-pointed triangle at the hoist bearing four red pales on yellow.
history: The flag was approved on 13 August 1990; it is an oblong flag of 2:3 with three equal stripes, green, black and green, representing the black castle on the green field of the arms (approved 12 July 1988), with a round-pointed triangle at the hoist representing the mount with the sign of Catalonia.
